text:
The TREC 2025 Product Recommendation task explicitly distinguishes complements, substitutes, and “complementary but unknown compatibility”—a useful foundation for separating functional relationships from verified compatibility ([task materials](https://huggingface.co/datasets/trec-product-search/product-recommendation-2025/discussions/1/files)). An adapted diagnostic taxonomy could label explicit specification conflicts, near-duplicate or substitute recommendations, supported complements, and insufficient evidence. Attach exact title/description spans from both products to each relationship claim; require conflicting specifications for incompatibility, and preserve unknown compatibility when specifications are missing. Similarity alone establishes neither redundancy for a particular user nor an unmet need. *Attribute or Abstain* (EMNLP 2024) finds that evidence quality predicts response quality more reliably for simple responses than complex claims, supporting narrowly scoped, independently checkable annotations ([paper](https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.463/)).

For the twenty simulator users, a proposed validation protocol is independent double annotation of recommendation–history-item pairs, followed by adjudication. Report raw agreement and Cohen’s κ for relationship labels, span overlap for evidence, and per-label counts; keep simulator usefulness feedback separate from specification judgments. Evaluate abstention with coverage, error among asserted labels, and risk–coverage curves, plus rates of unsupported assertions and unnecessary abstentions. These are proposed diagnostics, not measured results. ReCoVERR (2024) demonstrates in visual question answering that acquiring additional evidence can improve coverage without reducing accuracy; transfer to product diagnostics requires validation ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.15610)). Use only available histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; never convert interaction into ownership or infer ratings, unmet needs, diversity preferences, or conformity traits. Keep these exploratory diagnostics separate from the benchmark’s macro validation HR@10 selection criterion.
